verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street documents an employer-facing immigration service. It plugs into People Ops, runs multiple cases in parallel with SLAs and dashboards, designs the right visa from offer to start date, and keeps audit-ready records, so the company side of sponsorship is offered as a service. However, the evidence never names H-1B transfers or registrations, LCA compliance, or specific employer filings, and its visa content centers on O-1 and green card paths. missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration and transfer service, LCA filing and compliance documentation, an itemized list of the employer paperwork handled, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: We plug into your People Ops so nothing slips between candidate, manager, and attorney.
Run multiple cases in parallel with clean workflows, SLAs, and status dashboards.
We design the right visa up front, minimize RFEs, and move from offer to start date on a predictable timeline.
Protected data security, audit-ready records, and proactive policy updates.
